reason: Both sell to everyday consumers through drive-thru quick-service outlets and use app and rewards ordering. The products differ. Wendy's sells hamburgers, chicken sandwiches and breakfast meals. Dutch Bros sells specialty coffee, energy drinks and teas. Wendy's is a mostly franchised, large international burger brand. Dutch Bros is a drive-thru beverage chain. Customers and channel overlap, but the product does not, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
